snippet.title: Imagine Sisyphus Happy - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Imagine Sisyphus Happy, a philosophical idler simulation game developed by UnplayTheGame. Players will play the legendary tale of Sisyphus by pushing a boulder to the top as legend foretells, while livestreaming the entire ordeal. Do tricks, play mini-games, and unlock new struggles along the way. 

Imagine Sisyphus Happy is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

#ImagineSisyphusHappy
